caption:
Even famous actors with forty shows under their belt are one gig away from losing health insurance. Cheyenne Jackson launched an Instagram campaign to help union members hit their yearly minimum. When the system forces TV stars to hustle for random guest spots just to see a doctor, something is seriously broken. Would you trade a steady desk job for the Hollywood grind? 🎬📉

@instagram

Source: Variety

#Hollywood #CreatorEconomy #Union #Instagram #EntertainmentNews

post.news: Cheyenne Jackson launched the One Job Away campaign on Instagram to help actors meet the twenty-eight thousand dollar union health insurance minimum.
post.take: Being in forty TV shows and still begging Instagram for health insurance is a wild plot twist.
post.insight: Even top actors are struggling with broken union rules, proving that old systems do not fit the modern creator economy.
